tables.caption: Sequence and physico-chemical properties of cetacean cePrAMPs, identified by genome mining, compared to the active N-terminal fragment of the bovine PrAMP Bac7(1-35).

footnotes: * Results are reported as the median of 3 or more independent experiments (n ≥ 3).
